Author: alizea1337
Name: Keystroke
Punchline: Automates Keybound Brawler typing with humanized input, auto-queue and reward tracking.
Description: Keystroke reads Keybound Brawler prompts and types the answers for you, with humanized timing by default and an optional instant mode. Auto-queue loops with stop conditions, opens Keybound Coffers, tracks MGP/MGC gains, warns before the MGC cap, and offers global hotkeys and a compact in-duty overlay. Open /keystroke to get started.
Changelog:
New interface. A bevelled charcoal frame with a drifting cyan-lime-gold signal stripe, an icon
rail, and pages laid out as group boxes with cut-in titles. Checkbox rows, thin accent sliders,
inset fields, bevel buttons. The word being typed is shown as keycaps that press down as keys go
out, on the dashboard, the compact strip and the overlay. Six selectable accents; effects and
reduce-motion switches on the new "look" page. DejaVu Sans replaces Inter.

Author: alizea1337
Name: Provenance
Punchline: Turns a Teamcraft list into finished items: gathers, fishes, buys and crafts every material for you.
Description: Provenance takes a Teamcraft list (link, copied text or import string) or items you pick in its recipe browser, works out every material down to the crystals, then gets everything and crafts it in one run: items from your retainers, master books and folklore tomes from scrip exchanges (earning the scrips with collectables when needed), vendors, monster drops with a basic combo, its own gathering including timed nodes and collectables, its own fishing and spearfishing including mooch chains, Fisher's Intuition and fish windows, and crafting with Raphael rotations. No market board. Requires vnavmesh. Open /provenance to get started.
Changelog:
- Custom Deliveries and order runs: an NPC inside a building was flown at from outside, so the character ended
  up against the wall and stayed stuck there (R'dhyanki in Labyrinthos). The rules the Tribes run already uses
  for buildings now apply to every trip to a vendor, an appraiser or a delivery client: the run lands in the
  open near the building, gets off and walks in through the door, and it walks out of a building before it
  mounts up. Trips to gathering nodes and fishing holes go as before.
